description: This file defines the EmailUI class for handling email user interface components in SuiteCRM, including rendering email frames, managing folders, fetching mailbox nodes, and handling address book interactions.

classes.name: EmailUI
classes.description: Main class handling email UI rendering, folder management, mailbox interactions, and address book functions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayEmailFrame
methods.description: Renders the main email interface frame.

methods.name: displayQuickComposeEmailFrame
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML and JS for the quick compose email UI.

methods.name: _loadQuickCreateModules
methods.description: Loads available modules for quick email creation, checking ACL permissions.

methods.name: generateComposePackageForQuickCreateFromComposeUrl
methods.description: Parses a compose URL and generates a quick create email package.

methods.name: createEmailLink
methods.description: Creates an HTML mailto link for email addresses, optionally with JavaScript for modal compose.

methods.name: populateComposeViewFields
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML links for email addresses, considering opt-in and invalid email states.

methods.name: createBulkActionEmailLink
methods.description: Creates a bulk email action link.

methods.name: getEmailAddressConfirmOptInTick
methods.description: Retrieves opt-in status tick HTML for an email address.

methods.name: generateComposePackageForQuickCreate
methods.description: Generates a compose package JSON for quick create emails.

methods.name: _generateComposeConfigData
methods.description: Generates configuration data for email compose UI, including language packs and TinyMCE settings.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves user's address book contacts.

methods.name: setContacts
methods.description: Saves new contacts to user's address book.

methods.name: removeContacts
methods.description: Removes contacts from user's address book.

methods.name: saveContactEdit
methods.description: Saves edited contact info.

methods.name: getEditContact
methods.description: Prepares and returns the edit contact form.

methods.name: getUserPreferencesJS
methods.description: Retrieves user preferences as a JS-serializable array.

methods.name: getUserPrefsJS
methods.description: Alias for getUserPreferencesJS.

methods.name: saveNewFolder
methods.description: Creates and saves a new folder.

methods.name: saveListViewSortOrder
methods.description: Saves folder list view sort preferences.

methods.name: saveFolderOpenState
methods.description: Saves the open/closed state of folders.

methods.name: saveListView
methods.description: Saves folder view state.

methods.name: preflightEmailCache
methods.description: Creates cache folders if they do not exist.

methods.name: getMailboxNodes
methods.description: Builds mailbox nodes for the folder tree view, handling IMAP and group mailboxes.

methods.name: buildTreeNode
methods.description: Constructs a tree node object for the mailbox folder tree.

methods.name: getUnreadCount
methods.description: Returns unread email count for a mailbox.

methods.name: getDraftAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for draft emails.

methods.name: createCopyOfInboundAttachment
methods.description: Copies inbound email attachments into user cache.

methods.name: parseAttachmentInfo
methods.description: Parses HTML to extract attachment info.

methods.name: getQuickCreateForm
methods.description: Generates the quick create email form via Smarty.

methods.name: setReadFlag
methods.description: Sets the "read" flag in the overview cache for an email.

methods.name: markEmails
methods.description: Marks emails with the passed flag type, updating cache and remote server.

methods.name: doAssignment
methods.description: Performs email assignment to users, supporting folder-specific logic.

methods.name: doDistributionWithMethod
methods.description: Dispatches emails to users based on specified method.

methods.name: distRoundRobin
methods.description: Distributes emails on a round-robin basis.

methods.name: distLeastBusy
methods.description: Distributes emails to the least busy user.

methods.name: distDirect
methods.description: Distributes emails directly to a specified user.

methods.name: getAssignedEmailsCountForUsers
methods.description: Returns count of unread emails for each user.

methods.name: getLastRobin
methods.description: Returns the last user assigned in round-robin distribution from cache.

methods.name: setLastRobin
methods.description: Stores the last round-robin user in cache.

methods.name: getSingleMessage
methods.description: Returns metadata defining a single email message for display, optionally using cache.

methods.name: getListEmails
methods.description: Returns HTML listing emails in a folder, with optional cache validation.

methods.name: displayComposeEmail
methods.description: Prepares and displays the email compose form with address fields and content.

methods.name: handleReplyType
methods.description: Formats email body for reply/forward based on email type.

methods.name: arrayToXML
methods.description: Converts an array to XML format.

methods.name: getShowAccountsOptions
methods.description: Formats options for user account selection, including personal, group, and system accounts.

methods.name: getShowAccountsOptionsForSearch
methods.description: Formats options for account search filter.

methods.name: displaySuccessMessage
methods.description: Displays a success message after an email operation.

methods.name: validCacheFileExists
methods.description: Checks existence and validity of cache files for email data.

methods.name: getCacheValue
methods.description: Retrieves cached email data.

methods.name: getCacheTimestamp
methods.description: Gets the last modified timestamp of cache data.

methods.name: setCacheTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for cache validation.
